segment.description: Piney River, Rhea County, in the Spring City corridor on the Cumberland Plateau escarpment, running down to the Watts Bar embayment head (HUC 06010201). TWRA manages the reach as a Delayed Harvest trout water and spring-stocks it with catchable rainbows.
segment.boundaries: TWRA Delayed Harvest reach: 'Piney River: Cumberland Trail State Park downstream to Highway 27 Bridge' (catch-and-release Nov 1 - Feb 28). TDEC state scenic river segment: Moccasin Creek confluence downstream to RockHouse Branch (5.7 mi, Class I Natural River Area, designated 2020-06-22).

coldSource.notes: USGS 03542500 'PINEY RIVER AT SPRING CITY, TN' (Rhea County, HUC 06010201, altitude 749.65 ft, drainage 95.9 sq mi) is a discontinued station (daily record 1927-1931 only) — no current gauge or temperature record exists for the river: https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?sites=03542500&siteOutput=expanded&format=rdb. TDEC scenic-river page (segment identity above; no water-quality or fishery character stated): https://www.tn.gov/environment/natural-areas/tn-scenic-rivers/piney.html

holdover.detail: Program facet, not survival evidence: the Delayed Harvest season (catch-and-release, artificial lures only, Nov 1 - Feb 28) is supported by a late-October DH stocking (week of 10/25/2026, rainbows), meaning stocked fish are intended to be present through the winter months — but no evidence addresses summer carry-over.

wildPopulation.detail: Piney River (Rhea) is absent from TWRA's Wild Trout Streams list (that list covers Monroe/Carter/Johnson/Greene/Unicoi county waters only); no wild-trout survey record found.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: A managed put-and-take/delayed-harvest rainbow fishery (stocked Feb-Apr plus a late-Oct DH event, C&R Nov 1-Feb 28) exists, but there is no temperature, holdover, or wild-population evidence for the summer months on this ungaged river.
